results.summary: The product data can be approved with the clarification notes below.

findings.title: Warranty start date
findings.detail: Both quoted ratings are needed for this comparison.
findings.why_it_matters: Without a clear start date, we can’t track when the warranty begins or ends, which could lead to confusion if issues arise later.

compare.left_value: warranty start date = substantial completion date

findings.title: Labor warranty years
findings.detail: Installation labour warranty: 1.5 years from Substantial Completion to allow time for building occupant fit out, and occupant general use to identify defects.
findings.why_it_matters: Knowing the exact labor warranty period ensures we’re covered for installation-related problems during the critical early occupancy phase.

findings.title: other electrified hardware warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 3 years; spec requires at least 3 years.

findings.title: other mechanical hardware warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 10 years; spec requires at least 5 years.

findings.title: CSA Heavy Duty rating
findings.why_it_matters: Confirming the CSA Heavy Duty rating verifies the lock is built for high-traffic commercial use, which is essential for durability and safety on this project.

findings.title: cylindrical lock manufacturer series
findings.detail: Package states ND Series; allowed: Corbin CL3300 series, Schlage ND series, Sargent 10 line, LSDA-800 series.
